title: SpaceX Now Out-Launches Russia's Entire Program
source: SpaceX company launch totals (Wikipedia/SpaceNews orbital launch logs: 13 launches in 2019 rising to 134 in 2024). Russia figures are that country's total annual orbital launch attempts across every provider (CSIS Aerospace Security Project, Space Stats, TASS/Roscosmos year-end statements: 12-22 a year). A company vs. a nation isn't apples-to-apples, but that's the point of the chart -- one US company's cadence overtook an entire nation's space program's cadence in five years. Figures approximate as publicly reported.
